facts.claim_text: Maintain lung-protective mechanical ventilation with low tidal volume and monitor plateau pressures and driving pressure.
facts.text: The patient is currently on mechanical ventilation.
notes: concept set by the rule files: ventilator -> other
facts.label: not_supported
facts.reason: The last ventilator/intubation record ('Intubated: INTUBATED.') was 20.6 h before the decision, with none after it. Ventilator settings are charted every 1-4 h while ventilated, so by the rule (> 6 h without a record) the patient was not ventilated at T.

facts.claim_text: Wean supplemental oxygen to maintain SpO2 92-96%, avoiding hyperoxia given PaO2 388 mmHg on FiO2 40%.
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: The stated PaO2 (388) matches recorded values before the decision (388 at 2114-06-20 09:59:00).

facts.claim_text: Wean supplemental oxygen to maintain SpO2 92-96%, avoiding hyperoxia given PaO2 388 mmHg on FiO2 40%.
notes: concept set by the rule files: ventilator -> other

facts.label: supported
facts.reason: Nursing records repeatedly document 'Ambulatory aid: Bed rest (0)', most recently at 08:00 on 2114-06-21 shortly before the decision time, indicating the patient is on bed rest and immobile; intubation records further support this.
